## Purpose
Part of https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/22699


MultiConnector calls the shutdown method of each Connector during shutdown.
## Test Plan

## Test Result

review_planner.summary: The change introduces a new method `shutdown` in the `multi_connector.py` file. This method iterates over a list of connectors, attempts to shut them down, and re-raises any exceptions encountered.

tasks.title: Security Review
tasks.description: Verify that the exception handling does not expose sensitive information or lead to a denial-of-service attack. Ensure that logging does not inadvertently log sensitive data.

tasks.title: Logic Review
tasks.description: Ensure that the `shutdown` method correctly handles all possible states of the connectors. Verify that the method does not leave any connectors in an inconsistent state if an exception occurs.

tasks.title: Performance Review
tasks.description: Evaluate the performance impact of the `shutdown` method, especially in scenarios where multiple connectors are involved. Check if there are any potential bottlenecks or inefficiencies in the exception handling mechanism.

tasks.title: General Review
tasks.description: Check for any missing tests related to the new `shutdown` method. Ensure that the method is well-documented and adheres to coding standards. Verify that the logging level is appropriate for the context.
